subject: Mean Mass Spectrum from Orbitrap data imzML

messages.author: fed6dfe7aa6440f2
messages.subject: Mean Mass Spectrum from Orbitrap data imzML
parts:
Hello,

I have a question regarding generation of the mean spectum of a dataset generated by Orbitrap QExactive and converted to imzML. I can open the dataset and generate the ion images and plot mass spectrum. I would like at this point to exctract as .csv the mean mass spectrum of the entire dataset. 
I have used the following commnand

smean <- featureApply(treated_1, mean)


The problem is took a lot of time to generate the mean spectrum ( I left running overnight and still the processes is not completed. Is somebody experienced for such data set? 

Thank you very much in advance,

Best regards,
Marco

messages.author: 6033d3c0e7d242fa
messages.subject: Mean Mass Spectrum from Orbitrap data imzML
parts:
Using summarize(treat_1, .stat=“mean”, .as=“DataFrame”) should run a bit faster. Then use write.csv() on the result.

-Kylie

messages.author: fed6dfe7aa6440f2
messages.subject: Re: Mean Mass Spectrum from Orbitrap data imzML
parts:
Thank you Kylie! It works . :-) 

I have another related question. If I want to get the csv of a single pixel, what is the right script?

Marco

messages.author: db2a70d9b31cb1f7
messages.subject: Re: Mean Mass Spectrum from Orbitrap data imzML
parts:
Hi Marco,

I guess this does what you want:

as.matrix(iData(treat_1[,1])) ## intensities for the first pixel
## if you don't know the pixelnumber:
pixels(treat_1, coord=list(x=1, y=1))

Melanie
